question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given word.

Perplexed
solution:
The correct answer is: **Confused or puzzled**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Perplexed"** means feeling completely baffled or very confused. (उलझन में या हैरान)
 
 
• **Example: **She looked perplexed when she saw the complex math problem on the board.
 
 
• **"Confused or puzzled"** refers to a state of not being able to think clearly or understand something. (भ्रमित या हैरान)
 
 
• **Example: **The students were confused and puzzled by the unexpected twist in the story.
 
 
• Hence, the word **"Perplexed"** aligns best with **"Confused or puzzled."**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Confused or puzzled**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Confident and sure** (आत्मविश्वासी और निश्चित): Feeling certain about one's abilities or the correctness of something.
 
 
• **Example: **He was confident and sure about his decision to start his own business.
 
 
 
• **Happy and relieved** (खुश और राहत महसूस करना): Feeling joy and a sense of relief.
 
 
• **Example: **She was happy and relieved when she found her lost wallet.
 
 
 
• **Calm and relaxed** (शांत और आरामदायक): Free from stress, agitation, or excitement.
 
 
• **Example: **After a long day, he felt calm and relaxed while listening to soothing music.
